panel_source: FLI AI Safety Index Summer 2026 — Independent Review Panel

reviewers.name: David Krueger
institutional_affiliations: Assistant Professor in Robust, Reasoning, and Responsible AI, University of Montreal
Core Academic Member, Mila (Quebec AI Institute)
reviewers.notes: Confirmed panel member per FLI Summer 2026 2-pager. Expertise: AI alignment, safety, existential risks from advanced AI; founding Research Director of the UK AI Security Institute; initiated the CAIS Statement on AI Risk. Domain assignments are derived judgments from his published research focus; FLI does not publicly disclose per-reviewer domain-to-grade mapping.

reviewers.name: Sharon Li
institutional_affiliations: Associate Professor of Computer Science, University of Wisconsin-Madison
reviewers.notes: Confirmed panel member per FLI Summer 2026 2-pager. Expertise: algorithmic and theoretical foundations of safe and reliable AI; ICML 2026 Program Chair; Sloan Fellowship (2025), NSF CAREER, MIT Innovators Under 35. Domain assignments are derived judgments from her published research focus.

reviewers.name: Tegan Maharaj
institutional_affiliations: Assistant Professor in Machine Learning, HEC Montréal
reviewers.notes: Confirmed panel member per FLI Summer 2026 2-pager. Leads the ERRATA lab on Ecological Risk and Responsible AI at HEC Montréal. Domain assignments derived from her ecological-risk/responsible-AI research focus and her quoted commentary in the FLI report on 'ChatGPT-related psychosis incidents' under Current Harms.

reviewers.name: Sneha Revanur
institutional_affiliations: Founder and President, Encode (youth-led AI accountability organization)
reviewers.notes: Confirmed panel member per FLI Summer 2026 2-pager. Featured on TIME's inaugural list of 100 most influential people in AI. Domain assignments derived from Encode's youth-advocacy/governance remit; FLI does not publish per-reviewer domain mapping.

reviewers.name: Stuart Russell, OBE
institutional_affiliations: Professor of Computer Science, UC Berkeley
Director, Center for Human-Compatible AI (CHAI), UC Berkeley
reviewers.notes: Confirmed panel member per FLI Summer 2026 2-pager. Member, National Academy of Engineering; Fellow of the Royal Society; coauthor of the standard AI textbook used in 1500+ universities; OBE 2021. Quoted prominently in the FLI report on 'moving goalposts' weakening of pause commitments — a Safety Frameworks finding.

reviewers.name: Robert F. Trager
institutional_affiliations: Director, Oxford Martin AI Governance Initiative, University of Oxford
International Governance Lead, Centre for the Governance of AI (GovAI)
Senior Researcher, Department of Engineering Science, University of Oxford
reviewers.notes: Confirmed panel member per FLI Summer 2026 2-pager — NEW in Summer 2026 (not on Winter 2025 panel). Expertise: international governance of emerging technologies, diplomatic practice, institutional design, technology regulation; advises government and industry leaders.

reviewers.name: Yi Zeng
institutional_affiliations: Professor, Gaoling School of AI, Renmin University of China
Founding Dean, Beijing Institute of AI Safety and Governance (Beijing-AISI)
Director, Beijing Key Laboratory of Safe AI and Superalignment
Co-Chair, AI Committee of the World Internet Conference (WIC)
reviewers.notes: Confirmed panel member per FLI Summer 2026 2-pager. Serves on the United Nations Advisory Body on AI and the UNESCO Ad Hoc Expert Group on AI Ethics; TIME100 AI list. Domain assignments derived from Beijing-AISI / safe-AI-and-superalignment remit; the only panel member affiliated with a Chinese institution.

reviewer_continuity.continuity_note: FLI's own methodology preserves reviewer individual grades as confidential; only panel-level averaged domain scores are published. See https://futureoflife.org/ai-safety-index-summer-2026/ §Expert Evaluation: 'Final scores represent averaged expert assessments, with individual grades kept confidential.'

note: All seven names are taken verbatim from the published FLI Summer 2026 Independent Review Panel section of the AI Safety Index Summer 2026 2-pager (https://futureoflife.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/AI-Safety-Index-Report_010726_2Pager.pdf) and cross-confirmed against the FLI Summer 2026 scorecard page (https://futureoflife.org/ai-safety-index-summer-2026/). Domain assignments are derived judgments from each reviewer's published research focus; FLI does not publicly disclose which reviewer graded which domain.
